name: Cultural Landscape of Sintra
description: Tucked into the forested Sintra hills near Lisbon, this fairy-tale landscape grew from a ruined monastery that King Ferdinand II rebuilt in the 1800s as the Pena Palace. It mixes Gothic, Moorish, Egyptian and Renaissance touches, and its park blends local and exotic trees. Nearby villas, gardens and the medieval Castle of the Moors made Sintra Europe's first Romantic architecture hub.
